author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt Adam Savage answers Tested member questions about navigating big life and work transitions. From knowing how to move on after leaving a job you loved, to dealing with the dread of packing up a home or shop, Adam shares personal strategies for handling change. Plus, he discusses how to break out of creative demotivation slumps and into the mindset required to push through builds when they're not turning out well. With thanks to @dzdrums, @doineedone, @nahte1892 and @Mike-Is-Making-Stuff for their questions and support! What are your strategies for managing big life or work changes?
